== Japanese printed face ==
Full collector photograph visually transcribed and compared with the English printed face. The Japanese instructs that lost Life Force cards be placed face down in the Lost Pile. The English expressly prohibits viewing those cards when they are lost. The Japanese title adds “shining,” and its lore refers to a poor outlook rather than saying “I don't like the look of this.” Publication ID 1301_50o follows the approved Japanese catalog; this is not a GEMP implementation claim. Source preservation remains pending.
